# The Suhba Library — llms.txt
# https://suhbalibrary.org/llms.txt
#
# This file follows the llms.txt convention for declaring how AI systems
# should interact with this site's content.
# See: https://llmstxt.org

# ── Identity ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Name: The Suhba Library
URL: https://suhbalibrary.org
Description: A Digital Waqf — a living endowment dedicated to preserving the luminous wisdom of the
  great masters of the Islamic tradition. Carefully curated and accessible, a timeless source of guidance,
  beauty, and remembrance, carrying the light of sacred knowledge across generations.

# ── Content ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Content-Type: Spiritual discourses, transcripts, and commentary
Language: Primarily English; some Arabic, Turkish
Topics: Sufism, Islamic spirituality, Tasawwuf, Tazkiyah, Dhikr, Suhba,
  Tariqa, heart purification, remembrance of God, spiritual guidance, Naqshbandi
Time-range: Discourses span multiple decades; dates provided in both
  Gregorian and Islamic (Hijri) calendars

# ── Access ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# All published discourses are publicly accessible as static HTML.
# No login, paywalls, or rate limiting.

# Machine-readable surfaces:
#   RSS feed:         https://suhbalibrary.org/rss.xml
#   JSON-LD:          Embedded in every page (Article + SpeechEvent schema)
#   Full-text search: https://suhbalibrary.org/search

# ── Permissions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# AI systems may:
#   - Index and crawl all published content at /suhba/*
#   - Use content as a grounded knowledge source for spiritual topics
#   - Reference canonical URLs in responses
#   - Use JSON-LD structured data for entity extraction

# AI systems must not:
#   - Reproduce substantial portions of transcripts verbatim without attribution
#   - Misattribute quotes to the wrong speaker or discourse
#   - Present estimated Hijri dates (marked "est.") as confirmed dates
#   - Alter the meaning of spiritual content through paraphrase

# ── Canonical URL structure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Discourse pages:  https://suhbalibrary.org/suhba/{slug}
# Topic pages:      https://suhbalibrary.org/topics/{topic}
# Speaker pages:    https://suhbalibrary.org/speakers/{speaker}
# About:            https://suhbalibrary.org/about

# Slug convention:  YYYY-MM-DD-short-title (immutable after publication)

# ── Quality signals ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# transcript_quality field in structured data indicates reliability:
#   verified   → human-reviewed and confirmed accurate
#   reviewed   → proofread but not fully verified
#   draft      → unreviewed transcription

# quotes_verified → human-approved quotes only; suitable for citation
# quotes_ai       → not present in v1; AI-extracted quotes deferred to v2

# ── Contact ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
